subject: Word Sense Disambiguation
source_sentence: Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD)—the task of automatically selecting the most related sense for a word occurring in a context is considered as a main step in the course of approaching language understanding beyond the surface of the words.
title: Standard Test Collection for English-Persian Cross-Lingual Word Sense Disambiguation

subject: Evaluation
source_sentence: Two different evaluation methods are used for the task: 1) Best Result evaluation , in which the system suggests any number of translations for each target word, and the final score is divided by the number of these translations.
